这条链（{name}）上还没有部署擂台合约: The ladder contract is not deployed on this chain ({name})
正在发出第一笔交易，这笔交易就开打…: Sending the first transaction. It starts the play…
页面没有在推进这场挑战。: This page does not advance this challenge.
已超时：任何人都可以结算为守擂成功: Expired: anyone can settle it as a defense
页面正在自动发交易。同一个账户最多 3 笔在途，收到回执以后再发下一笔。: The page sends the transactions. At most 3 are in flight per account. The next one goes out after a receipt.
到第 {block} 块以前不能再挑战这个擂主: No new challenge against this defender before block {block}
条形是权重字节数和上限的比。第 1 名的条是强调色。: The bar is the weight size against the maximum. The bar of rank 1 is in the accent colour.
登录以后，比你的出战模型高 1 到 {range} 名、不在冷却中、没有在挑战中: After the login, the rows 1 to {range} ranks above your entry that are not in cooldown and not in a challenge show the Challenge button.
余额不够付典型的一场挑战，先给钱包充值: The balance does not pay a typical challenge. Fund the wallet first.
余额够典型的一场，但是不够最坏的一场（600 步）: The balance pays a typical challenge, but not the worst one (600 steps).
页面会自动发出这场挑战的全部交易，不再弹窗确认。关掉页面以后，在超时以前回来还能: The page sends every transaction of this challenge without a confirmation popup. If you close the page, come back before the timeout to continue.
挑战者赢（{c} ≤ {limit}，比擂主小 δ = {delta}% 以上）: Challenger wins ({c} ≤ {limit}: smaller than the defender by at least δ = {delta}%)
擂主守擂（挑战者要 ≤ {limit} 字节才能靠 δ = {delta}% 赢: Defense (the challenger needs ≤ {limit} bytes to win by δ = {delta}%)
把工作台里训练的坦克网络注册成出战模型，挑战排在你上面的出战模型。裁判是链上合约: Register the tank network you trained in the workbench as an entry, then challenge the entries above you. The referee is a contract on chain. Every challenge has a replay that anyone can reproduce.
登录并注册出战模型: Log in and register an entry
在工作台里用模板“坦克大战”训练网络，看胜率和平局率。: Train a network with the template Tank Battle in the workbench. Check the win rate and the draw rate.
在候选模块里导出接受的候选，得到一个 JSON 文件。: Export the accepted candidate from the candidates module. You get a JSON file.
登录以后导入这个文件，部署到官方 Factory，然后注册。新出战模型从最后一名: Log in, import the file, deploy it through the official Factory, then register. A new entry starts at the last rank.
这是本地开发链：登录用的是 anvil 默认助记词的账号，任何人都知道它的私钥。: This is the local dev chain: the login uses an account of the anvil default mnemonic. Its private key is public.
挑战的 gas 由你的钱包付，先给钱包充值 MON。: Your wallet pays the gas of a challenge. Fund it with MON first.
赛季剩余块数（到第 {end} 块）: Blocks left in the season (until block {end})
先登录，然后注册出战模型。: Log in first, then register an entry.
本地开发：登录用 anvil 默认助记词的账号 #{index}。: Local development: the login uses account #{index} of the anvil default mnemonic.
从工作台的候选模块导出的 JSON 文件。页面先核对它的内容 id，然后通过官方: The JSON file that the candidates module of the workbench exports. The page checks its content id, deploys it through the official Factory, then registers it.
本地链：gas 由 anvil 账号付: Local chain: the anvil account pays the gas
名字设置以后不能改。: A name cannot change after it is set.
上次关掉页面时，{name} 的挑战 #{id} 还没打完。: Challenge #{id} of {name} was not finished when the page closed.
比分是挑战者赢的局数 : 擂主赢的局数。gas 是这场挑战全部交易用掉的 gas: The score is the episodes the challenger won : the episodes the defender won. Gas is the gas of all transactions of the challenge.
回放由种子、事件里的动作和模板的场景重建，页面不读任何权重。: The replay is rebuilt from the seed, the actions in the events and the scene of the template. The page reads no weights.
两局用同一个种子，两方交换阵营。地图转 180° 不变，所以一个照抄动作的副本在: Two episodes use the same seed, and the two sides change places. The map stays the same after a turn of 180°, so a copy that plays the same actions cannot win a mirror pair against the original.
一场挑战是 3 个镜像对，共 6 局。挑战者赢的局数多于擂主，挑战成功。一局打满: A challenge is 3 mirror pairs, 6 episodes. The challenge succeeds when the challenger wins more episodes than the defender. After 100 steps, the side with more lives wins the episode.
平局看权重字节数: Ties go to the smaller weight size
两方赢的局数相等时，挑战者的权重字节数不大于擂主的 (1 − δ) 倍才算赢。δ: When both win the same number of episodes, the challenger wins only if its weight size is at most (1 − δ) times the defender's. δ = {delta}%. Every other result is a defense.
只能挑战比自己高 1 到 {range} 名的擂主。挑战成功时，挑战者占擂主的名: An entry can challenge a defender 1 to {range} ranks above it. When the challenge succeeds, the challenger takes the rank of the defender, and the defender and each entry between them move down by one rank.
发起交易的最低 gas: Minimum gas of the start transaction
种子来自第一笔交易所在块的 PREVRANDAO 和挑战编号。只有没有代码的普通: The seed comes from the PREVRANDAO of the block of the first transaction and the challenge id. Only an account without code can start a challenge, and the gas limit of the start transaction has a minimum. So a challenger cannot see the seed before it decides to play.
已知的限制：打乱权重块顺序的副本权重不同，可以注册，并且可以排到原版的下一名。它: Known limit: a copy with its weight chunks in another order has different weights. It can enter, and it can sit directly below the original. It cannot win a mirror pair against the original.
已知的限制：前提是挑战者控制不了验证者，也收买不了验证者。出块的验证者能提前知道: Known limit: the challengers must not control or bribe the validators. The validator of a block knows the PREVRANDAO of its own block in advance.
任何人都能用种子、事件里的动作和模板的场景复现一场挑战的每一步。回放就是这样算出: Anyone can reproduce every step of a challenge from the seed, the actions in the events and the scene of the template. The replay is computed that way.
anvil 默认助记词的账号，只用于本地开发: An account of the anvil default mnemonic, for local development only
这个模块不是官方 Factory 部署的，擂台只接受官方 Factory 的模块: This module was not deployed by the official Factory. The ladder accepts only modules of the official Factory.
模型的输入必须是 572 位，输出必须是 9 个分数: The model must have 572 input bits and 9 output scores
权重字节数 {size} 超过上限 {max}: The weight size {size} is above the maximum {max}
已经有一个出战模型的权重和它完全相同，副本不能占名次: An entry with exactly these weights exists. A copy cannot take a rank.
带工具层的网络不能参赛: A network with tool layers cannot enter
这个模块已经是出战模型: This module is already an entry
这个模块不是出战模型: This module is not an entry
只有没有代码的普通账号（EOA）能发起挑战: Only an account without code (EOA) can start a challenge
发起交易的 gas limit 至少要 {gas}: The gas limit of the start transaction must be at least {gas}
只能挑战比自己高 1 到 {range} 名的出战模型: An entry can challenge only entries 1 to {range} ranks above it
这个出战模型正在挑战中，一次只能发起一场: This entry is in a challenge. It can start only one at a time.
冷却中：到第 {block} 块以前不能再挑战这个擂主（还要等 {left} 块: Cooldown: no new challenge against this defender before block {block} ({left} blocks to wait)
冷却中：这一对挑战者和擂主还不能再打: Cooldown: this challenger cannot challenge this defender yet
赛季已经结束，不再接受新的挑战: The season is over. The ladder accepts no new challenge.
只有注册这个出战模型的账号能用它发起挑战: Only the account that registered this entry can start a challenge with it
这场挑战已经超时，算擂主守擂成功: This challenge expired. It counts as a defense.
出战模型的 forward 调用失败: The forward call of an entry failed
合约配置无效: The contract configuration is not valid
名字只能用英文字母、数字、空格、_ 和 -: A name uses only English letters, digits, spaces, _ and -
名字含违禁词: The name contains a banned word
这个名字已经有人用了（不区分大小写）: This name is taken (case does not matter)
这个出战模型已经有名字了，名字设置以后不能改: This entry already has a name. A name cannot change after it is set.
只有注册这个出战模型的账号能起名字: Only the account that registered this entry can name it
模块地址无效: The module address is not valid

棋盘里的“我方”是第 0 方，“机器人”是第 1 方。颜色和上面的两方一致。: The board says “ours” for side 0 and “robot” for side 1 (the text of the template). The colours match the two sides above.
